title: Tech Note: An Introduction to Ajax
author: Joe Resuello, Technical Marketing Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note is a general-audience introduction to Ajax as a web technique (JavaScript, XML, HTML, CSS) aimed at 4D developers unfamiliar with web development, culminating in a pitch for the 4D Ajax Framework as 4D's own Ajax toolkit. The historical/conceptual explanation of Ajax remains broadly accurate, but the framework it promotes (4DAF) has been discontinued, and the drag-and-drop Dreamweaver-based workflow it describes reflects web development practices long since superseded by modern JavaScript frameworks and 4D's own current web/REST tooling.
related_updates: The 4D Ajax Framework (4DAF) has been discontinued and is not part of current 4D products
4D's web development approach has since moved to a built-in Web Server with REST/ORDA APIs, consumed by modern JavaScript frameworks rather than the 4DAF client/component model
